description: NaBaPdH₃ crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃/mmc space group. Na is bonded to six equivalent H atoms to form NaH₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PdBa₂H₃ trigonal bipyramids, edges with six equivalent BaH₆Pd₂ hexagonal bipyramids, and faces with two equivalent NaH₆ octahedra. All Na-H bond lengths are 2.36 Å. Ba is bonded to two equivalent Pd and six equivalent H atoms to form BaH₆Pd₂ hexagonal bipyramids that share corners with eight equivalent BaH₆Pd₂ hexagonal bipyramids, corners with six equivalent HBa₂Na₂Pd trigonal bipyramids, edges with six equivalent NaH₆ octahedra, and edges with three equivalent PdBa₂H₃ trigonal bipyramids. Both Ba-Pd bond lengths are 3.10 Å. All Ba-H bond lengths are 3.04 Å. Pd is bonded to two equivalent Ba and three equivalent H atoms to form PdBa₂H₃ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with six equivalent NaH₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent PdBa₂H₃ trigonal bipyramids, corners with twelve equivalent HBa₂Na₂Pd trigonal bipyramids, and edges with three equivalent BaH₆Pd₂ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 41°. All Pd-H bond lengths are 1.74 Å. H is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Ba, and one Pd atom to form distorted HBa₂Na₂Pd trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent BaH₆Pd₂ hexagonal bipyramids, corners with four equivalent PdBa₂H₃ trigonal bipyramids, corners with twelve equivalent HBa₂Na₂Pd trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent HBa₂Na₂Pd trigonal bipyramids, and faces with two equivalent HBa₂Na₂Pd trigonal bipyramids.
